message.Title: Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL enhanced Burstable tier (Basv2)

Body.Content:
Enhanced Burstable tier (Basv2) builds on the existing burstable model with improved performance predictability and more efficient burst utilization, delivering a better cost-performance balance. Now you can run steady workloads more economically while automatically scaling to handle demand spikes.

 Learn more.
